title: Vikram and Betal: The Patient Farmer
moral: Patience and hard work lead to success.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a farmer.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a hardworking farmer.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The farmer’s crops did not grow well at first.
scenes.image_prompt: farmer looking worried at dry field cartoon

scenes.text: The farmer kept working and caring for his fields.
After some time, the crops grew strong and healthy.
scenes.image_prompt: green healthy crops in field cartoon

scenes.text: The farmer succeeded through patience. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.

story: A farmer did not give up even when his crops failed. With patience and hard work, he succeeded. Vikram said patience leads to success.
